This section contains slides and supporting materials from BSU professional
development meetings. Each presentation is published as its own article so it
can be viewed and shared independently.

## Presentation topics

- [Using Git within RStudio](professional-development-using-git.html) — Set up
  Git, work with branches, and contribute changes through pull requests.

- [Working with AI Tools](professional-development-working-with-ai-tools.html) —
  Surface level introduction to AI tools and how to use them.

- [Power and Sample Size in R](professional-development-power-sample-size.html) —
  Conducting power and sample size calculations in R.

- [Weighted Quantile Sum Regression](professional-development-wqs.html) —
  A review on weighted quantile sum regression and its extensions.

- [Proportional Odds Logistic Regression](professional-development-polr.html) —
  An overview of Proportional Odds Logistic Regression (POLR).

- [Contal and O'Quigley Method](professional-development-contal-oquigley.html) —
  An overview of the Contal and O'Quigley Method.

- [Using Predicted Probabilities as Covariates in Causal Mediation](professional-development-causal-mediation.html) —
  Using predicted probabilities as covariates in causal mediation analysis.

- [The Method of Recycled Predictions](professional-development-recycled-predictions.html) —
  An overview of the method of recycled predictions.

- [Propensity Scores](professional-development-propensity-scores.html) —
  An overview of propensity score methods.

- [Multi-Institutional EHR Networks](professional-development-ehr-networks.html) —
  An overview of multi-institutional electronic health record (EHR) networks.

- [Missing Values in Proteomics](professional-development-missing-values-proteomics.html) —
  Handling missing values in proteomics data.

- [MAIHDA](professional-development-maihda.html) —
  An overview of Multilevel Analysis of Individual Heterogeneity and
  Discriminatory Accuracy (MAIHDA).

- [Drift Monitoring Program Overview](professional-development-drift-monitoring.html) —
  An overview of the drift monitoring program.

- [Continuous Real-time Data Analysis](professional-development-real-time-data-analysis.html) —
  Continuous real-time data analysis, presented at the 2024 Conference on
  Statistical Practice (CSP).
